get.description:
Retrieves a list of all categories with their hierarchical structure.
Each category includes its immediate children. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new category with the provided information. Requires authentication.

get.description:
Retrieves detailed information about a specific category, including its children.
Requires authentication.

put.description:
Updates a category's information. All fields in the request body are optional.
Requires authentication.

delete.description: Soft deletes a category by marking it as deleted. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new product with optional variants, sell prices, and stocks. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a single product by its ID. Requires authentication.

delete.description: Soft deletes a product and all its variants by ID. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a list of suppliers with optional filtering and pagination. Requires authentication.

post.description: Creates a new supplier with the provided information. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a single supplier by its ID. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates a supplier's information by ID. Requires authentication.

delete.description: Deletes a supplier by ID. Requires authentication.
